reconfigure.title: Change controller host
reconfigure.description: Enter the new address of the controller belonging to this entry. Existing devices and entities are retained. If this controller is still configured in legacy YAML, remove that YAML device and restart Home Assistant first.

error.invalid_host: Enter an IPv4 address, an IPv6 literal without a zone, or an ASCII hostname. Do not include a scheme, port, path or credentials.
error.yaml_not_checked: Home Assistant has not loaded the HWAM startup configuration yet. Complete integration startup before changing the host.
error.yaml_configuration: The old host is still present in loaded or current HWAM YAML. Remove that YAML device and restart Home Assistant before changing its host.
error.yaml_check_failed: The YAML configuration could not be checked. Correct the configuration and try again; the host has not been changed.

abort.already_in_progress: Configuration of this host is already in progress.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The host was saved and Home Assistant was asked to reload this entry. Check the integration status; this does not confirm successful reload.
abort.reconfigure_unchanged: The normalized host is unchanged. The entry was not modified or reloaded.
abort.reconfigure_entry_changed: This entry changed or was removed during validation. Reopen configuration to review its current settings.
abort.reconfigure_cancelled: Configuration was cancelled. The host was not changed.
abort.reconfigure_not_ready: This entry is not ready for a host change. Finish normal setup/migration or resolve the existing lifecycle error first; no recovery or registry migration was attempted.

night_times_not_synchronized.message: The current night times must be read from the stove again before they can be changed.

command_not_confirmed.message: The stove did not confirm the command. The command may already have been carried out.

deprecated_import_from_configuration_yam.title: Deprecated configuration
deprecated_import_from_configuration_yam.description: YAML configuration is deprecated. At the last YAML check, of {total} syntactically distinct hosts, {configured} have a config entry and {missing} still have none (pending or failed import). Repeated YAML hosts: {duplicates}; at most one import is attempted per host, and existing entries and names are kept. New entries use the YAML device key as their name; the optional name field is not used. This reports entry presence, not successful integration setup or complete legacy migration. monitored_variables is not migrated: Config Entries use the current entity defaults, not the former YAML sensor selection. Review entity enablement and verify every controller in Settings before removing its YAML configuration. Missing controllers remain unimported; inspect the logs and correct their configuration before the next restart.
